name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.153.0 — Doctor repair: the test-skip rule states the invariant instead of enumerating files (the list had rotted twice); spec-status stops flagging ticked queue items as orphans and stops swallowing a header label written below Depends on; .env reads denied; contract hash re-stamped for the optional postGateCommand/testNameFilter keys this host does not declare. 7.152.0 — The client exclusions card now explains itself: a heading counts the rows, a lead poses the question and warns that an unanswered row is recorded as not contested when the work is signed off, and each row constructed from the client's own words (an answer or a withdrawn request) quotes them beside the paraphrase, naming the screen they came from. Every answered row — agreed, needed, or dropped by a retired source — renders a state sentence instead of buttons, held by data-verdict, and the in-session render after pressing a button matches the reload render exactly. 7.151.0 — Tests expire at close: a spec's tagged tests are deleted at review close unless they cite a ledger escape class, exercise a script the pipeline itself runs, or pin an opt-in SHALL CONTINUE TO criterion dated on or after 20260911. An AC-ID defined by more than one spec counts as done only when every spec defining it is done, so a number collision can never delete an unfinished spec's tests. The review row records tests:{born,kept,retired} and the close commit carries the deletions; /spec:doctor gains check 20 to run the same rule as a dry run across every done spec in a host, applying only after one question naming the count and the files.
